recentItems.title: Silent Hill Townfall - Official Launch Trailer
recentItems.description: Don't miss this launch trailer for Silent Hill Townfall! The latest entry in the survival horror series, Silent Hill Townfall takes you to coastal town of St.Amelia, now drenched in the signature fog with horrible beasts hiding in the corners of the town. Explore the mystery of just what happened in St Amelia when Silent Hill Townfall launches on September 24th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam), and Xbox Series X|S, or buy the deluxe edition to get access on September 22nd!

recentItems.title: Silent Hill: Townfall Review
recentItems.description:
Silent Hill: Townfall reviewed by Tristan Ogilvie on PlayStation 5. Also available on PC.

"Off the back of the more action-oriented sidestep of 2025’s Silent Hill f, Silent Hill: Townfall feels like Konami’s seminal survival horror series returning to what it does best. Its atmosphere is oppressively ominous, its central mystery is genuinely compelling to unravel and packed with themes that feel fresh, and its army of disfigured demons are exhilarating to both encounter and evade. The CRTV device that spots enemies hidden in your surroundings might slightly diminish the story’s ability to deliver major scares early on, but when Townfall eventually got me, it made sure it got me good. It also has some of the most cleverly designed and challenging puzzles I’ve experienced in any horror game in recent memory, many involving impeccable recreations of technology from yesteryear that really transported me back to its mid-nineties setting. Like the intravenous needle permanently jutting out of its hero’s wrist, Silent Hill: Townfall gives this long running series a welcome shot in the arm."

recentItems.title: Mad Ever After - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Mad Ever After, a co-op fantasy first-person roguelike shooter developed by Fubu Games. Players will fight through fantastical realms with magic-based staffs, powerful spells, and larger-than-life bosses to handle. Mad Ever After is coming soon to PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Full Belly Breakout - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Full Belly Breakout, a first-person, decision-based adventure game developed by Zxima.llc. Players will seek out what lies among the plethora of dishes to enjoy every bite and ultimately escape their cell. Full Belly Breakout is coming soon to PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Endless Legend 2 - Official Rogue Factions Overview Trailer
recentItems.description:
Join narrative director Jeffrey Spock from developer Amplitude Studios for a deep dive into the Rogue Factions coming to Endless Legend 2 in the strategy game's 1.0 release. Learn about these playable Rogue Factions, which feature a new set of traits for a different strategic approach, quests, and more. The new video breaks down what to expect from the Order of Zelevas splinter faction of the Kin of Sheredyn and the Severed Claws splinter faction of the Necrophage. 

Version 1.0 of Endless Legend 2 will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, Xbox on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on September 17, 2026.

recentItems.title: Escape From Playtime - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
recentItems.description:
Escape From Playtime gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and an early access release date. Watch the latest Escape From Playtime trailer for the upcoming co-op survival horror game set within the Poppy Playtime universe, deep inside the decaying halls of the abandoned Playtime Co. The new trailer features a creepy voiceover explaining what you need to do to survive. Escape From Playtime will be available in Steam Early Access on October 21, 2026.

In Excape From Playtime, players explore the facility as the Smiling Critters, the dead-eyed toy line with gaping smiles introduced in Poppy Playtime: Chapter 3. From classrooms and warehouses to testing labs and the dark corridors connecting them all, every space in the factory becomes more dangerous when seen from a Critter’s-eye view.

recentItems.title: Tempest Rising - Official ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion Release Date Trailer
recentItems.description: Here's a look at ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion Release Date Trailer for Tempest Rising, a real-time strategy game developed by Slipgate Ironworks. Players can get a new look at the upcoming expansion that brings 11 new missions from the perspective of the Veti, a powerful and technologically advanced faction established in previous instances in the game. Take on ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion in Tempest Rising on September 29 for PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Blackwood - Official Game Overview Trailer
recentItems.description: Take a look at the Game Overview Trailer for Blackwood, a third-person action-adventure game developed by AttritoM7 Productions. Players will run a DVD store by day and embody a ruthless assassin by night, with intense melee combat and tight gunplay. Get the rundown on the game's offerings with Blackwood, launching on September 16 for PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Risk of Rain 2 - Official Acolyte and Enforcer Survivors Reveal Trailer
recentItems.description: Meet two new survivors coming to Risk of Rain 2 in this latest trailer for the roguelike action game. The Acolyte is a close-range glaive-wielding Survivor who can wield powerful combos, but not without cost. The Enforcer is a defensive vanguard and a Survivor who combines powerful defense with dynamic, tactical movement. The Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts expansion will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.

recentItems.title: Weed Out - Official Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Weed Out, a bullet heaven roguelike developed by QuokkaPlay. Players will take on dangerous plants that have gone awry. Dispatch over 190 unique plant-based enemies, complete challenges, and dish out combos. Weed Out is coming soon to PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Foundlings - Official Demo Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the latest Foundlings trailer for this upcoming RPG. Guide two troubled mages through a civil war-torn 12th-century England in this spellcasting RPG. Forge spells by combining conduits, trade favours with lords and serfs, watch the motions of the planets and keep your Humours in check as you help them find their purpose. Foundlings will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
